```json
{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Use Spring Framework 6.0 with Java 17 as the target runtime, consistent with the current Spring framework requirements.",
    "Use Spring Data abstraction for the persistent stream repository to provide pluggable backend support (e.g., JDBC, JPA, in-memory).",
    "Design the pluggable Runtime SPI as a set of Java interfaces with a default implementation, enabling deployment-target-specific implementations (CF, on-prem, Mesos, etc.).",
    "Implement the Receptor Java client as a standalone library/jar that can be reused by XD, exposing a high-level, type-safe API that maps onto the underlying REST API of Diego/Receptor.",
    "Use Maven (multi-module) as the build system, following existing Spring XD module conventions.",
    "Adopt a JPA/Hibernate-based persistence layer for the stream/job definition repository to keep the implementation portable across supported SQL stores.",
    "Stream/job definition repository refactoring will target decoupling from spring-xd-module-deployer concerns, introducing a new abstraction layer (StreamJobDefinitionRepository) with a clean interface.",
    "Import Options parameterization will use Spring's @Value and SpEL with named options to replace the generic --args mechanism.",
    "Spark Streaming pipeline integration will rely on XD's existing Spark support, refactored to take advantage of the new Runtime SPI.",
    "Documentation will be authored in AsciiDoctor (consistent with Spring XD docs) and stored alongside the codebase under src/main/asciidoc."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "A single experienced developer with working knowledge of Spring XD, Spring Framework 6, and Java 17 performs all tasks.",
    "1 workday = 8 productive hours; calendar overhead, meetings, and waiting time are not included in the effort estimate.",
    "The existing Spring XD codebase, build infrastructure, CI environment, and test harnesses are already in place; only incremental work is estimated.",
    "The Receptor API is documented and stable; the client does not need to handle undocumented behaviors.",
    "No external stakeholders (product, QA, release engineering) are billed against the developer estimate.",
    "Unit, integration, and smoke tests are written by the same developer as part of each activity.",
    "Persistent repository uses a generic SQL backend; specific database tuning or migration tooling is out of scope.",
    "Documentation updates (U5, U7) are limited to writing/reviewing content; no docs-platform infrastructure work is required.",
    "Code review is treated as a separate cross-cutting activity to account for the multi-component nature of the increment.",
    "Tasks are executed sequentially by a single developer; no parallelism or task-switching overhead is modeled."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Project setup and environment preparation",
      "activity_description": "Create/branch new modules, update parent POMs, configure Spring Framework 6.0 / Java 17 toolchain, set up local CI smoke test, and prepare base package structures for the new artifacts (Receptor client, persistent repository, Runtime SPI).",
      "most_likely_effort": 2
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Implement Receptor Java client (U1)",
      "activity_description": "Analyze Receptor REST API, design and implement a Java client library (DTOs, HTTP layer, error handling), provide a fluent API surface for use by XD, write unit and integration tests, and produce usage examples.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "Refactor stream/job definition repository (U2)",
      "activity_description": "Analyze existing XD repository, extract module-deployment concerns behind a new abstraction, introduce a clean StreamJobDefinitionRepository interface, migrate callers, and ensure existing tests pass.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Design and implement pluggable Runtime SPI (U3)",
      "activity_description": "Define runtime SPI interfaces (RuntimeDeploymentProvider, RuntimeTaskLauncher, etc.), provide a default in-process implementation, add at least one additional pluggable target implementation (e.g., Cloud Foundry), wire into XD's module-deployer, and write contract tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Implement persistent stream repository (U4)",
      "activity_description": "Design persistence schema for stream metadata, implement a JPA-based repository implementation behind the U2 abstraction, add restart/rehydrate logic that reestablishes streaming pipes after failure, and cover with unit and integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 12
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Document Sqoop escape-quote behavior (U5)",
      "activity_description": "Investigate current Sqoop job submission behavior, write a concise documentation section explaining the need to double-escape \\N in XD Sqoop jobs, and submit a documentation patch.",
      "most_likely_effort": 2
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Implement streaming pipeline integration with Spark/Spark Streaming (U6)",
      "activity_description": "Update XD stream model to align with current Spark/Spark Streaming specs, refactor the Spark integration module to use the new Runtime SPI, ensure end-to-end stream creation, deployment, and execution against Spark, and validate with integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 15
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Document nesting of batch jobs and workflows in XD (U7)",
      "activity_description": "Author reference documentation covering how to define and run nested batch jobs and composed workflows in XD, include concrete examples, edge cases, and limitations; review with team.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "Parameterize Import Options (U8)",
      "activity_description": "Identify all current Sqoop Import Options exposed by XD, refactor them into named, individually-parameterizable options (removing the generic --args mechanism), update CLI/batch layer, maintain backward compatibility tests, and update user-facing documentation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-component integration testing and bug fixing",
      "activity_description": "Run end-to-end integration suites across the new Receptor client, Runtime SPI, persistent repository, Spark pipeline changes, and parameterized import options; triage and fix any regressions discovered.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Code review, refactoring, and quality hardening",
      "activity_description": "Self-review of all new and modified code, apply coding-style and static-analysis fixes, refactor duplication, and harden error handling and logging across the increment.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A12",
      "activity_name": "Final documentation consolidation and release notes",
      "activity_description": "Update top-level user/reference docs to reflect the new abstractions, write release notes covering U1–U8, and ensure all new public APIs are documented.",
      "most_likely_effort": 2
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 78
  }
}
```

activities.activity_description: Create/branch new modules, update parent POMs, configure Spring Framework 6.0 / Java 17 toolchain, set up local CI smoke test, and prepare base package structures for the new artifacts (Receptor client, persistent repository, Runtime SPI).

Analyze Receptor REST API, design and implement a Java client library (DTOs, HTTP layer, error handling), provide a fluent API surface for use by XD, write unit and integration tests, and produce usage examples.

Analyze existing XD repository, extract module-deployment concerns behind a new abstraction, introduce a clean StreamJobDefinitionRepository interface, migrate callers, and ensure existing tests pass.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement pluggable Runtime SPI (U3)
activities.activity_description: Define runtime SPI interfaces (RuntimeDeploymentProvider, RuntimeTaskLauncher, etc.), provide a default in-process implementation, add at least one additional pluggable target implementation (e.g., Cloud Foundry), wire into XD's module-deployer, and write contract tests.

Design persistence schema for stream metadata, implement a JPA-based repository implementation behind the U2 abstraction, add restart/rehydrate logic that reestablishes streaming pipes after failure, and cover with unit and integration tests.
Investigate current Sqoop job submission behavior, write a concise documentation section explaining the need to double-escape \N in XD Sqoop jobs, and submit a documentation patch.

activities.activity_name: Implement streaming pipeline integration with Spark/Spark Streaming (U6)
activities.activity_description: Update XD stream model to align with current Spark/Spark Streaming specs, refactor the Spark integration module to use the new Runtime SPI, ensure end-to-end stream creation, deployment, and execution against Spark, and validate with integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Document nesting of batch jobs and workflows in XD (U7)
activities.activity_description: Author reference documentation covering how to define and run nested batch jobs and composed workflows in XD, include concrete examples, edge cases, and limitations; review with team.

Identify all current Sqoop Import Options exposed by XD, refactor them into named, individually-parameterizable options (removing the generic --args mechanism), update CLI/batch layer, maintain backward compatibility tests, and update user-facing documentation.

activities.activity_name: Cross-component integration testing and bug fixing
activities.activity_description: Run end-to-end integration suites across the new Receptor client, Runtime SPI, persistent repository, Spark pipeline changes, and parameterized import options; triage and fix any regressions discovered.

activities.activity_name: Code review, refactoring, and quality hardening
activities.activity_description: Self-review of all new and modified code, apply coding-style and static-analysis fixes, refactor duplication, and harden error handling and logging across the increment.

activities.activity_name: Final documentation consolidation and release notes
activities.activity_description: Update top-level user/reference docs to reflect the new abstractions, write release notes covering U1–U8, and ensure all new public APIs are documented.
